about_the_game:
All scenes are fully animated with Spine2D!!　
A smooth-touching simulation experience!!　

　

・Story

Inside a swaying train. The defenseless figure of a girl lingers constantly before your eyes.

You can't help but reach out—your hand touches the girl's body.

　

The vivid sensation. As your fingers savor every movement,

the girl neither resists nor raises her voice. She simply endures. And your moral boundaries begin to crumble.
　

　
　

・How to Play

Gently touch the girl's body to earn points.

Use points to unlock new plays and features!

　

Touching, undressing, rubbing, insertion, and more.

Various types of play await you!

　
　

　

・Content

Three scenes on the train. One scene in the ending.

A total of four scenes, all animated using Spine2D!

　

Just like the old-school simulation-style erotic Flash games:

Touch, undress, and thrust with your mouse.

Incorporates real-time physics reactions for more realism.

　

Unlock features like toys (rotors, dildos) and cross-section view displays!

　

　

Game Features

・Total of 4 scenes
・Fully animated with Spine2D

Interact, undress, press together, insert — all controlled easily with the mouse!

・Every scene includes undressing mechanics!

Just like retro simulation-style erotic Flash games:

Touch, strip, thrust — all directly controlled with the mouse.

・Half-undressed school uniform

・Legs spread

Grab the knees and open them!

Hold the hem and lift it up!

・Final Scene in a Toilet Stall

・Unlocked Under Certain Conditions

Includes cross-section view that syncs with motion,

and a body that reacts with physics based on mouse movement.

Other Information
